facts: Teknisa documents automatic NFC-e through the Interface API.
A dedicated cash register configured for NFC-e is required.
The Interface API must be operational.
The cash register must be open and active.
Automatic issuance applies only to eligible paid-order/payment flows described by the product.
Partner order integration is intended to operate autonomously through Odhen Retail.
Teknisa warns against partner tools that interfere with the configured integration.
Delivery cash-register configuration is part of the supported integration model.

conclusions.recommended_path: Confirm supported Interface/API contract and applicability to the current iFood/Odhen flow before any fiscal effect.
